name: Xbox Rain Droplets
description: Brings back the rain running down the screen the way the Xbox 360 version had it - drops that gather on the camera and are wiped away by speed and wind. The PC release dropped the effect. Settings for size, amount and speed are in plugins\GTAIV.XboxRainDroplets.ini.

sources.note: By ThirteenAG. The project serves several games, each under its own release tag - this is the gtaiv one. The archive has no plugins folder of its own, so the step puts it there.
